lessons.title: Binance users withdraw $3.6bn after record crypto hack
lessons.title_zh: 幣安用戶在創紀錄的加密貨幣駭客攻擊後提領 36 十億美元

paragraphs.en: Binance customers recently withdrew more than 3.6 billion dollars of assets from the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. This massive movement of funds happened as the platform reopened following a record-breaking cyber attack.
paragraphs.zh: 幣安的客戶最近從全球最大的加密貨幣交易所提領了超過 36 十億美元的資產。這筆龐大的資金流動發生在該平台在經歷了一次創紀錄的網路攻擊後重新開放之際。

paragraphs.en: The firm previously paused all transactions because of the security incident, which impacted digital assets worth 6.3 billion dollars. Major organizations, including the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation, which is known as the FBI, have accused North Korea of being responsible for the dangerous hack, describing it as the largest breach in history.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司先前因該安全事件而暫停了所有交易，該事件影響了價值 6.3 十億美元的數位資產。包括被稱為 FBI 的美國聯邦調查局在內的主要組織，已指責北朝鮮必須為這次危險的駭客攻擊負責，並將其形容為歷史上最大規模的入侵。

paragraphs.en: The company stated that it has covered about 95 percent of the stolen assets, though the remaining amount might take longer to source. Binance has repeatedly promised that it will cover all losses linked to the attack.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司表示，它已經補足了約 95% 被竊取的資產，儘管剩餘的金額可能需要較長的時間來籌措。幣安已多次承諾，它將承擔與該攻擊相關的所有損失。

paragraphs.en: According to the company, there was an initial surge in withdrawals, but these actions later slowed down and are stabilizing as expected. The business also mentioned that withdrawals for major digital currencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum have resumed, and more services will return in phases once security checks are finished.
paragraphs.zh: 根據該公司的說法，提領一開始出現激增，但這些動作隨後放緩，並如預期般趨於穩定。該企業也提到，比特幣和以太幣等主要數位貨幣的提領已經恢復，且一旦安全檢查完成，更多服務將分階段恢復。

paragraphs.en: Early checks suggest the security problem may have started with a compromised laptop belonging to an engineer. This allowed hackers to find a way to complete unauthorized transactions, though the withdrawn crypto represents only a fraction of the total assets held by Binance, which had more than 160 billion dollars in its custody in 2024.
paragraphs.zh: 早期檢查顯示，安全問題可能始於一名工程師所擁有的一台遭入侵筆記型電腦。這讓駭客得以找到完成未授權交易的方法，儘管被提領的加密貨幣僅佔幣安所持有總資產的一小部分，該公司在 2024 年在其保管中有超過 160 十億美元。

grammar.explain: 本句使用關係代名詞 which 引導子句，用來補充說明前面的安全事件。
grammar.example: The firm previously paused all transactions because of the security incident, which impacted digital assets worth 6.3 billion dollars.
grammar.focus: which impacted digital assets worth 6.3 billion dollars

grammar.explain: 本句使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞 (is known as)」來表達主詞被稱為某稱謂的被動狀態。
grammar.example: Major organizations, including the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation, which is known as the FBI, have accused North Korea of being responsible for the dangerous hack, describing it as the largest breach in history.

grammar.explain: 本句使用「have + 過去分詞 (have covered)」來表達過去發生的動作對現在造成的影響或結果。
grammar.example: The company stated that it has covered about 95 percent of the stolen assets, though the remaining amount might take longer to source.

lessons.title: Has Trump kept his promises to the MAHA movement?
lessons.title_zh: 川普是否兌現了他對「讓美國再次健康」運動的承諾？

paragraphs.en: A little over two years ago, Donald Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. teamed up to create the Make America Healthy Again, or MAHA, movement. Their ambitious goals included lowering rates of chronic illnesses, improving the nation's food system, and eliminating toxic chemicals. Today, supporters are divided over whether the administration has actually delivered on these major campaign promises.
paragraphs.zh: 兩年多前，唐納・川普（Donald Trump）與小羅勃・甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）聯手發起了「讓美國再次健康」（Make America Healthy Again，簡稱 MAHA）運動。他們的宏大目標包括降低慢性疾病的發病率、改善國家的食品體系，以及清除有毒化學物質。如今，支持者對於政府是否確實履行了這些重大的競選承諾意見分歧。

paragraphs.en: On one hand, the administration introduced new dietary guidelines that pleased many followers. These rules raised daily protein targets and encouraged Americans to avoid processed items while eating more saturated fat. However, environmental policies have sparked sharp disappointment. Kelly Ryerson, an activist from the nonprofit American Regeneration, argued that the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) had weakened drinking water rules and approved harmful pesticides instead of protecting public health.
paragraphs.zh: 一方面，該政府推出了讓許多支持者感到高興的新飲食指南。這些規則提高了每日蛋白質目標，並鼓勵美國人避免加工食品，同時攝取更多飽和脂肪。然而，環境政策卻引發了強烈的失望。來自非營利組織「美國再生」（American Regeneration）的倡議人士凱莉・萊爾森（Kelly Ryerson）主張，環境保護局（EPA）削弱了飲用水法規並核准有害殺蟲劑，而非保護大眾健康。

paragraphs.en: A major conflict involves glyphosate, a common chemical in weedkillers linked to cancer concerns. Although many health advocates wanted strict limits, the administration supported the chemical company in a significant Supreme Court case. Furthermore, Trump signed an executive order to boost the domestic production of this pesticide, which left numerous grassroots activists feeling betrayed.
paragraphs.zh: 一個重大的衝突牽涉到草甘膦（glyphosate），這是一種存在於除草劑中且與癌症疑慮有關的常見化學物質。儘管許多健康倡導者希望實施嚴格限制，該政府卻在一場重大的最高法院訴訟中支持該化學公司。此外，川普還簽署了一項行政命令來促進該殺蟲劑的國內生產，這讓眾多基層運動人士感到被背叛。

paragraphs.en: Health experts also doubt that chronic illnesses have decreased. Barry Popkin, a nutrition professor at the University of North Carolina, found no clear evidence of progress. Instead, he highlighted major measles outbreaks caused by anti-vaccine attitudes, along with severe foodborne illness incidents. In addition, a recent summit in Washington was filled with corporate executives, leading Ryerson to admit, "I don't even recognize this iteration of MAHA."
paragraphs.zh: 公共衛生專家也懷疑慢性疾病是否有所減少。北卡羅來納大學（University of North Carolina）的營養學教授巴里・帕普金（Barry Popkin）發現沒有任何明確的進展證據。相反地，他強調了因反疫苗態度引發的嚴重麻疹疫情，以及嚴重的食源性疾病事件。此外，近期在華盛頓舉行的一場高峰會充斥著企業高層，這讓萊爾森坦言：「我甚至認不出這個版本的 MAHA 了。」

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative clause introduced by a relative pronoun)
grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 that 所引導的形容詞子句，用來修飾先行詞 new dietary guidelines，在子句中作主詞。
grammar.example: On one hand, the administration introduced new dietary guidelines that pleased many followers.

grammar.explain: 動詞形式 had weakened... and approved... 表示該行為發生在主要子句過去式動詞 argued 之前。
grammar.example: Kelly Ryerson, an activist from the nonprofit American Regeneration, argued that the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) had weakened drinking water rules and approved harmful pesticides instead of protecting public health.
grammar.focus: had weakened drinking water rules and approved harmful pesticides

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to boost the domestic production of this pesticide 表目的，回答「簽署行政命令是為了什麼」。
grammar.example: Furthermore, Trump signed an executive order to boost the domestic production of this pesticide, which left numerous grassroots activists feeling betrayed.
grammar.focus: to boost the domestic production of this pesticide

lessons.title: University staff warned of 'difficult decisions' ahead over finances
lessons.title_zh: 大學教職員因財務狀況收到未來面臨「艱難決定」之警告

paragraphs.en: Staff at Queen's University Belfast (QUB) have received a warning about tough choices ahead as the institution faces serious financial problems. In a message sent to employees, Vice-Chancellor Professor Sir Ian Greer explained that the university suffered a deficit of around £12.5 million during the previous financial year. This difficult situation arose mainly after government funding from the Northern Ireland Executive was significantly reduced for 2025/26.
paragraphs.zh: 貝爾法斯特女王大學（QUB）的教職員收到警告，由於該校正面臨嚴重的財務問題，未來將面臨艱難的抉擇。校長伊恩·格里爾教授（Professor Sir Ian Greer）在發給員工的訊息中解釋，學校在上一財政年度出現了約1,250萬英鎊的赤字。這種困境主要是在北愛爾蘭行政院大幅削減2025/26年度的政府補助之後出現的。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, university earnings have dropped. Greer noted that a decline in tuition fees, along with government budget cuts, forced the school to control costs. Stricter visa rules for international students entering the United Kingdom caused international student fee revenue to fall from over £60 million in 2024 to about £55 million in 2025. Furthermore, student recruitment income is projected to end up approximately £7 million below its original target.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，大學的收入也出現下滑。格里爾指出，學費收入下降加上政府預算削減，迫使學校必須控制成本。針對進入英國的國際學生所實施的更嚴格簽證規定，導致國際學生的學費收入從2024年的超過6,000萬英鎊，下降到2025年的約5,500萬英鎊。此外，學生招募收入預計將比原定目標短少約700萬英鎊。

paragraphs.en: Government rules have also limited student numbers. Due to an official cap decided by the Department for the Economy, the university had to reject around 500 local applicants who met the grade requirements. To deal with these pressures, the management board intends to identify roughly £10 million in savings. Consequently, campus parking fees for staff are rising, while agreed pay deals, childcare costs, and sports center fees are being reviewed and could increase.
paragraphs.zh: 政府規定也限制了學生人數。由於經濟部所制定的官方名額上限，該校不得不拒絕約500名達到成績標準的在地申請者。為了因應這些壓力，管理委員會打算找出約1,000萬英鎊的節省開銷方案。因此，校園內的教職員停車費正在調漲，而原本已同意的薪資待遇、托兒服務費用和體育中心費用也正在重新評估且可能會提高。

paragraphs.en: Despite these financial cutbacks, construction will continue on a new visitor and heritage center located in the Quad. A university spokesperson explained that such investments aim to create income and provide teaching space to support future growth. Greer emphasized that despite upcoming changes, "the student experience must remain central to our decisions" as the school seeks long-term stability.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管面臨這些財務緊縮，位於方庭（Quad）的一座新訪客與傳承中心工程仍將繼續進行。大學發言人解釋，這類投資旨在創造收入並提供教學空間以支持未來的成長。格里爾強調，儘管即將進行各項變動，但當學校尋求長期穩定之際，「學生體驗必須維持在我們決策的核心地位」。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 在子句中作主詞，修飾先行詞 local applicants。
grammar.example: Due to an official cap decided by the Department for the Economy, the university had to reject around 500 local applicants who met the grade requirements.

grammar.point: 現在完成式被動語態 (Present Perfect Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: have been reduced 由「have + been + 過去分詞」構成，表示過去到現在已被減少的狀態。
grammar.example: This difficult situation arose mainly after government funding from the Northern Ireland Executive was significantly reduced for 2025/26.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to create income 在句子中作目的副詞，用來修飾動詞 aim，表達投資的目的為何。
grammar.example: A university spokesperson explained that such investments aim to create income and provide teaching space to support future growth.

lessons.title: Wild West crypto: Staggering Binance heist exposes sector fragility
lessons.title_zh: 蠻荒西部般的加密貨幣：幣安驚天劫案暴露該產業的脆弱性

paragraphs.en: Recently, hackers stole more than $6 billion from the Binance crypto exchange, making it the biggest heist in cryptocurrency history. Investigators widely believe that the North Korean military broke into investor accounts used to trade digital currencies like Bitcoin. Following the attack, Binance promised to repay every user who suffered losses. The company also announced that it has managed to freeze around $3 billion of the stolen funds as it works to recover the rest.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，駭客從幣安（Binance）加密貨幣交易所竊取了超過 60 億美元，使其成為加密貨幣史上規模最大的一起劫案。調查人員普遍認為北韓軍方侵入了用來交易比特幣等數位貨幣的投資者帳戶。在遭遇攻擊後，幣安承諾會賠償每位蒙受損失的使用者。該公司還宣布，在努力追回其餘款項的同時，他們已成功凍結了約 30 億美元遭竊的資金。

paragraphs.en: This massive incident has sparked new fears about the security of the cryptocurrency market. Experts point out that the unique structure of crypto exchanges creates serious risks. Amanda Fischer from the financial advocacy group Better Markets explained that traditional stock investors do not leave their money with exchanges. Instead, they keep funds with brokers who are regulated by government authorities and carry insurance. In contrast, crypto platforms allow users both to trade and to store their assets directly on the exchange.
paragraphs.zh: 這起重大事件引發了人們對加密貨幣市場安全性的新擔憂。專家指出，加密貨幣交易所的獨特結構帶來了嚴重的風險。來自金融倡議團體「更健全市場」（Better Markets）的 Amanda Fischer 解釋說，傳統股票投資者並不會將資金留在交易所。相反地，他們將資金存放在受到政府主管機關監管並備有保險的經紀人手中。相較之下，加密貨幣平台則允許使用者直接在交易所進行交易並存放資產。

paragraphs.en: This single location for trading and holding assets makes crypto exchanges tempting targets for cybercriminals. In addition, these platforms do not face the same strict regulations as established banks. Without strong legal protections, firms may be tempted to misuse customer funds during difficult periods. A similar crisis occurred in 2022, when the prominent exchange FTX collapsed after improperly handling user money.
paragraphs.zh: 這種結合交易與保管資產的單一場所，使加密貨幣交易所成為網路罪犯極具誘惑力的目標。此外，這些平台並不像老牌銀行那樣面臨同樣嚴格的法規約束。在缺乏強力法律保障的情況下，企業可能會在艱困時期忍不住挪用客戶資金。2022 年就曾發生過類似的危機，當時知名的 FTX 交易所因不當處理使用者資金而崩潰。

paragraphs.en: Critics argue that the cryptocurrency industry wants benefits without responsibility, claiming to be safe while resisting the rules that govern Wall Street. Despite the huge theft, strict new rules seem unlikely to arrive soon because recent leadership has promised lighter oversight. Under these conditions, consumer advocates warn ordinary investors that they must remain very careful when dealing with cryptocurrencies.
paragraphs.zh: 批評人士認為，加密貨幣產業想要享有利益卻不願承擔責任，一邊聲稱自己很安全，一邊又抗拒管理華爾街的規則。儘管發生了這起巨額竊案，新的嚴格法規似乎不太可能很快推出，因為近期的領導層已承諾會放寬監管。在這些情況下，消費者倡議人士警告一般投資人，在接觸加密貨幣時必須保持高度謹慎。

grammar.explain: 由逗號隔開的現在分詞片語「making...」表示主要子句事件所產生的自然結果。
grammar.example: Recently, hackers stole more than $6 billion from the Binance crypto exchange, making it the biggest heist in cryptocurrency history.
grammar.focus: making it the biggest heist in cryptocurrency history

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 連接詞 that 引導完整的名詞子句，在主要動詞 explained 後面充當受詞。
grammar.example: Amanda Fischer from the financial advocacy group Better Markets explained that traditional stock investors do not leave their money with exchanges.
grammar.focus: that traditional stock investors do not leave their money with exchanges

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 在子句中作主詞，用來修飾先行詞 every user。
grammar.example: Following the attack, Binance promised to repay every user who suffered losses.
